**No – Krishna Iyer (S2025CS003) cannot renew the hostel room for the next academic year until the overdue fee is cleared.**

**Why**

| Item | Detail |
|------|--------|
| CGPA | 7.45 ≥ 6.0 → meets the academic criterion [Doc: Hostel Rules & Allotment Policy 2026-27 §3] |
| Overdue dues | Tuition installment ₹87,000 unpaid (outstanding balance ₹87,000) [SQL] |
| Renewal rule | “no overdue fee dues of any kind in the fee ledger” is required for renewal [Doc: Hostel Rules & Allotment Policy 2026-27 §3] |
| Consequence of overdue | Students with any overdue entry are **not eligible for hostel renewal** [Doc: Fee Payment & Refund Policy 2026-27 §5] |
| Renewal window | 1 Apr – 30 Apr 2027 (not yet open) [Doc: Hostel Rules & Allotment Policy 2026-27 §3] |

**What to do**  
Clear the ₹87,000 tuition overdue (pay the full amount or arrange a settlement) to obtain a no‑dues certificate; then you will be eligible to apply for renewal during the 1‑30 Apr 2027 window.
sql: SELECT s.student_id, s.full_name, s.cgpa, fl.component, fl.amount_due, fl.amount_paid, fl.due_date, fl.status, (fl.amount_due - fl.amount_paid) AS outstanding_balance FROM students AS s JOIN fee_ledger AS fl ON fl.student_id = s.student_id WHERE s.student_id = 'S2025CS003' AND fl.status = 'overdue' ORDER BY fl.due_date LIMIT 50
